end.summary:
Ishita discussed cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere.
They identified a gas cylinder as cylinder-shaped and a sphere as ball-shaped.
They described a cylinder as having two circles and a curved middle surface.
They connected a cube with equal sides, square faces, dice and an ice cube tray.
Teach-back was not passed; no misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming and describing cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere with Ishita. Ishita used familiar examples such as a gas cylinder, ball, dice and an ice cube tray, and described the cylinder’s two circular ends and curved middle. They asked for clearer pictures several times, so at home you can use real objects or draw each solid and say its name together.
